_comment: Curated publish titles (YouTube title + thumbnail header) per course, keyed by course id. Search-first: what someone would actually type, never 'Course 4'. One entry per course in src/content/index.ts.
intro: GCP Data Engineering for Beginners: What We'll Build, a Live Stream and a Nightly Batch, and the Whole Architecture
how-gcp-runs: How Google Cloud Works: Regions and Zones, the Resource Hierarchy, APIs per Project, Control and Data Planes, and Billing
start: Terraform on Google Cloud for Beginners: gcloud Sign-in, a First Bucket, Remote State with a Lock, Modules and a Budget
secure: Google Cloud IAM Explained: Roles and Inheritance, Service Accounts without Key Files, PERMISSION_DENIED, Secret Manager and Cloud KMS
land: Cloud Storage for Data Engineers: a Raw Zone, Partitioned Paths, a Manifest and a Failing Gate, Retention and Lifecycle Rules
stream: Google Cloud Pub/Sub Explained: Topics and Subscriptions, Pull and Ack, At-Least-Once Delivery, Ordering Keys and Dead Letters
dataflow: Apache Beam and Dataflow Explained: Event Time, Fixed Windows, Watermarks and Late Data, Dedupe, Sessions, Streaming into BigQuery
lakehouse: BigQuery Lakehouse: Datasets, External Tables, Bronze and Silver, How a Query Runs, Partitioning and Clustering, SCD2 and Quality Gates
dataproc: PySpark on Dataproc: Local First, the BigQuery Connector, a Skewed Join and Salting It, Dataproc Serverless, Writing to Gold
serve: BigQuery for Analytics: a Gold Table, Unique Counts with HLL, Query Cost, Authorized Views, Materialized Views, BI Engine and Looker
orchestrate: Apache Airflow on Google Cloud: a DAG, Sensors, Retries and SLAs, a Failed Night, Idempotent Backfill, and Cloud Composer
operate: Operating a GCP Data Platform: Policy Tags, Sensitive Data Protection, Dataplex Lineage and Quality, Logging, Alerts and Cloud Build CI
